item: Parts bar: a refused split keeps its set only on 404 and 409; the saving-set drop is pinned
status: shipped (follow-up to R115, node-tested, mutation-checked; browser walk of #1286 unchanged)
summary: The Opus delta read of #1286's final commit found a set an again press had just fetched and whose save was still going was not covered when the split failed, and a 404 (no archive) was treated like a post-sweep failure. A failed split now keeps the bar's set only after a 404 or 409, both refused before the previous archive's files are swept; any other failure drops it, stops its save loop, hides the bar and empties the status. Six mutants of the clause all fail the node test.
